object_description: narrow longitudinal five-story block with two access cores
design_condition: The narrow block is set back from the river and moderately from the street, creating a generous river landscape, connected forecourt, and relaxed street-side delivery and parking areas.

positive.statement: The careful landscape planning creates a varied sequence of recreational and outdoor spaces with high usage value.

position.rationale: River-side and forecourt landscape are approximated around the elongated building footprint.

positive.statement: The generous distance from the river mitigates the relationship between building length and height.

position.rationale: The building’s river setback is represented along the north-side open edge.

positive.statement: The school takes a self-confident position in relation to its surroundings.

position.rationale: The consolidated block’s outer west edge represents its confident contextual stance.

positive.statement: The two consistently connected vertical axes are arranged in an operationally advantageous manner.

position.rationale: Central and lower internal point clusters indicate two vertically organized access cores.

positive.statement: The urban integration of the striking school is a notable contribution in harmony with the external spatial qualities.

position.rationale: The long, narrow elevated block is anchored on its prominent east-facing envelope.

positive.statement: The consolidation into one building is impressive despite its considerable length and height.

position.rationale: Continuous perimeter points across the five-story volume support a single consolidated mass.

negative.statement: The horizontal zoning and lack of openings across floors provide little exchange between departments.

position.target: horizontal zoning and lack of openings
position.rationale: Repeated horizontal elevation bands and sparse openings are clearest on the side façades.

negative.statement: The even horizontal facade structure is not entirely understandable given the partly over-high ground floor.

position.rationale: The south elevation shows regular horizontal structure above a disproportionately tall lower level.

negative.statement: The structural rigor leads internally to a somewhat schematic and less collective school operation.

position.rationale: Internal operation is not distinguishable; a constrained mid-building anchor represents the criticism.
